dialog.english: How far do we have to keep going?

Until we're somewhere Etemon can't
reach.
dialog.translation:
A donde Etemon no
nos alcance.

dialog.english: So where's that?
Whew...it's so hot.

Keep yourselves together, guys.
We've got a Crest now, right?

Yeah, but...are we even sure we
can use it to make the Digimon
evolve?
dialog.translation:
Sí, pero...¿seguro que sirve
para hacer evolucionar a
los Digimon?

dialog.english: They can! Right, Agumon?
Yeah...

Stay sharp! You're the only one
here who can evolve any further.
dialog.translation:
¡Ojo! Eres el único que
puede evolucionar más.

dialog.english: Yeah...
All right! Okay, guys, cheer up!
cheer up!
cheer up!
Yeah...
It's an oasis!
We can finally rest.
Look, there's fruit!
You're right, wow!
Perfect! Let's take a break here.

I guess there's nothing else we
can do, so we'll take a break!
dialog.translation:
¡Ya que no hay nada más que
hacer, descansemos!

dialog.english:
I should collect some food for
now...
dialog.translation:
Debería recoger algo de
comida ya...

dialog.english:
It's probably dangerous
to go off by myself.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que es peligroso
ir solo por ahí.

dialog.english:
We're so unlucky...Etemon had to
find us just when we'd made it to
Server Continent.
dialog.translation:
Qué mala suerte...Etemon nos
encontró justo cuando llegamos
al Continente Server.

dialog.english:
The sheer scope of Etemon's power
threw us for a loop, and now
everyone's too scared.
dialog.translation:
El poder de Etemon es tan
grande que nos dejó en shock,
y ahora todos tienen miedo.

dialog.english:
Tai, can you let me inspect
your Crest later? Maybe I can
figure something out.
dialog.translation:
Tai, ¿me dejas examinar tu
Emblema luego? Quizás pueda
averiguar algo.

dialog.english: All right, I'll leave it to you!
Let me think about it a bit more.
All right, I'll leave it to you!

If I figure out the relationship
between the Tag and Crest, I can
learn how Digimon evolve further.
dialog.translation:
Si averiguo la relación entre
el Circuito y el Emblema, sabré
cómo evolucionan los Digimon.

dialog.english:
Yeah, right now we're depending on
this Crest.
dialog.translation:
Sí, ahora dependemos de
este Emblema.

dialog.english: Let me think about it a bit more.

Tai, right now we don't know
anything about this Crest...
dialog.translation:
Tai, ahora mismo no sabemos
nada de este Emblema...

dialog.english:
I know! But if I don't have the
Crest at a time when we need it,
Agumon won't be able to evolve...
dialog.translation:
¡Lo sé! Pero si no tengo el
Emblema cuando haga falta,
Agumon no podrá evolucionar...

dialog.english: Tai...

There's food scattered in the
bushes, but it looks like they
grow in small portions.
dialog.translation:
Hay comida por los
arbustos, pero parece que
crece en poca cantidad.

dialog.english:
I wish we could have stayed in the
Koromon village, just for a bit
longer...
dialog.translation:
Ojalá nos hubiéramos quedado
un poco más en la
aldea Koromon...

dialog.english:
Gomamon! If you swim in the oasis,
we can't drink from it!
dialog.translation:
¡Gomamon! ¡Si nadas en el
oasis, no podremos beber!

dialog.english: Don't worry, I like being clean!
That's not the problem...

Gomamon, how long are you gonna
keep swimming?

Hey, hey, Tokomon! How come the
only water around here is at the
oasis?
dialog.translation:
¡Oye, Tokomon! ¿Por qué solo
hay agua en el oasis?

dialog.english:
Hmm, I dunno. Maybe you should ask
Izzy?
dialog.translation:
No sé. ¿Quizás deberías
preguntarle a Izzy?

dialog.english: Okay! Let's go ask him together!
I hope Tokomon evolves soon.

Yeah! I'm really trying my best to
protect you.
Obtained DigiMelon!

Huh, so there's real food here!
Maybe there's more elsewhere.
dialog.translation:
¡Vaya, aquí hay comida de
verdad! Habrá más por ahí.

dialog.english:
Okay, good, good. Let's keep
looking.
We found a lot of food.
Yeah, this'll be enough!

Hey, Izzy. How do you think
we're supposed to evolve our
Digimon to the next level?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Izzy. ¿Cómo crees que
hacemos evolucionar a
nuestros Digimon?

dialog.english:
Evolving...considering what we've
seen before, it seems like energy
is necessary.
dialog.translation:
Evolucionar...según lo que
vimos antes, parece que hace
falta energía.

dialog.english: Energy?

Evolved Digimon need a large
amount of energy.
I see...

And there are many cases in which
Digimon have evolved when their
partners were in danger...
dialog.translation:
Y hay muchos casos en que
los Digimon evolucionan
si su compañero peligra...

dialog.english: Energy and danger, huh.
Agumon, I'm stuffing you with food!
What do you think, guys?

Eh?! But that's all the food we
just gathered!
dialog.translation:
¡¿Eh?! ¡Es toda la comida
que acabamos de reunir!

dialog.english:
It's the only way! You're the only
one who can beat Etemon!
dialog.translation:
¡Es la única forma! ¡Eres el
único que puede vencer a
Etemon!

dialog.english: What should we do...
We can't stop him.

There's still a lot we don't know, 
and it doesn't look like the 
Digimon know any more than we do.
dialog.translation:
Aún hay mucho que no sabemos,
y parece que los Digimon
tampoco saben más que nosotros.

dialog.english:
And we don't know what the Crests
do to make them evolve.
dialog.translation:
Y no sabemos qué hacen los
Emblemas para que evolucionen.

dialog.english:
There's no use in rushing to
figure it out.
dialog.translation:
No sirve de nada apresurarse
a averiguarlo.

dialog.english:
I mean, shouldn't we try out the
things we *do* know?
dialog.translation:
O sea, ¿no deberíamos probar
lo que sí sabemos?

dialog.english: Try?
I can't eat any more! Bleh...

No! Everyone gave you their food
because they're looking forward to
your evolution!
dialog.translation:
¡No! ¡Todos te dieron su
comida porque quieren verte
evolucionar!

dialog.english: Yeah...
My share of food...

But we can't evolve to the next
level, so...
dialog.translation:
Pero no podemos evolucionar,
así que...

dialog.english:
That's why both of us have to do
our best!
dialog.translation:
¡Por eso debemos dar
lo mejor los dos!

dialog.english: I feel bad for Agumon...

Yeah, it's like Tai's pushing
Agumon into a corner.
dialog.translation:
Sí, es como si Tai acorralara
a Agumon.

dialog.english:
Tai was always kind to us
juniors in club, but...
dialog.translation:
Tai siempre fue majo con
los peques del club, pero...

dialog.english:
Even when he seemed to be just
rushing into things, he would
usually consider his surroundings.
dialog.translation:
Aunque pareciera que iba a
lo loco, siempre solía
pensar en los demás.

dialog.english: Huh...that's a surprise.

Now that he's got that Crest,
something about him seems to have
changed.
dialog.translation:
Desde que tiene ese Emblema,
parece que algo en él
ha cambiado.

dialog.english: Ah!
What's wrong, Joe?
My Tag's reacting to something!

...! There's a building over
there!

The Crest must be in there. Let's
go!
Yeah!
Whoa!
Are you okay? Joe!
Ow, ow. Pesky cable!
Huh? Why's there a cable here?
Huh? Why's there a cable here?

Meanwhile, while the Chosen
Children were tracking the Crest
down...
dialog.translation:
Mientras los Niños Elegidos
buscaban el Emblema...

dialog.english: Ghigi!!
What's wrong, Lord Etemon?

Something got caught in the
network.
dialog.translation:
Algo quedó atrapado en
la red.

dialog.english: Where?

The Colosseum, the one where I
hold my yearly concert.
dialog.translation:
El Coliseo, donde doy mi
concierto anual.

dialog.english: Huh? That's pretty far from there.

But I've got an interesting show
set up there. Ghighighi!
dialog.translation:
Pero tengo un espectáculo
interesante preparado. ¡Jijiji!

dialog.english:
When you look at it up close, it's
pretty old...
dialog.translation:
De cerca, se ve bastante
viejo...

dialog.english: It looks like the Roman Colosseum.
What's that?
An ancient stadium.

The Tag's giving off an even
stronger reaction!

So the Crest really is in here.
Let's go in!
dialog.translation:
Así que el Emblema sí está
aquí. ¡Entremos!

dialog.english: Yeah!
There's a soccer goal here!

Okay, let's split up and look for
the Crest!

Whew, I can't move anymore. I'm
gonna rest...
dialog.translation:
Uf, no puedo más. Voy a
descansar...

dialog.english: Hey, keep it together!

Let him rest. Our only clue is
this Tag, anyway.
dialog.translation:
Déjale descansar. Solo
tenemos este Circuito.

dialog.english:
Joe and I will go look for the
Crest, so the rest of you should
take a break!
dialog.translation:
¡Joe y yo buscaremos el
Emblema, así que los demás
descansad!

dialog.english: I'll go with you!

He said that the tag's our only
clue, so we wouldn't be of much
help.
dialog.translation:
Dijo que el Circuito es
nuestra única pista, no
seríamos de mucha ayuda.

dialog.english:
I wonder if we'll really find the
Crests by just wandering around
the continent...
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto si encontraremos
los Emblemas solo vagando
por el continente...

dialog.english:
Yeah. We don't even know how far
away a Crest could be when the Tag
reacts.
dialog.translation:
No sabemos cuán lejos puede
estar un Emblema si reacciona
el Circuito.

dialog.english: A soccer goal, huh?
You play soccer, right, Sora?
Yeah, but my mom's against it...
dialog.translation: Sí, pero mi madre no quiere...

dialog.english:
I don't see any mysterious
characters like the ones in the
other ruins.
dialog.translation:
No veo símbolos misteriosos
como los de otras ruinas.

dialog.english:
Well, it's not like seein' one set
of ruins lets you see 'em all.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, ver unas ruinas no
significa haberlas visto todas.

dialog.english:
Isn't it weird, having a soccer
goal here? Did ancient people
really play soccer?
dialog.translation:
¿No es raro tener una portería
aquí? ¿Jugaban al fútbol
los antiguos?

dialog.english:
Don't ask me things I don't know
about, Mimi.
dialog.translation:
No me preguntes lo que no sé,
Mimi.

dialog.english:
The Crest should be somewhere in
this colosseum...
dialog.translation:
El Emblema debe estar en
este coliseo...

dialog.english: Is the Tag still reacting?

Yeah, and stronger than ever. I
think it's close...
dialog.translation:
Sí, más fuerte que nunca.
Creo que está cerca...

dialog.english: Aren't you hot, Tokomon?

If I were Patamon, I could cool
you down by flapping my wings,
but...
dialog.translation:
Si fuera Patamon, podría
refrescarte con mis alas,
pero...

dialog.english:
You'll be able to evolve! Hang in
there!

I'm sorry, Tai, I can't move
anymore...let me rest...
dialog.translation:
Lo siento, Tai, no puedo
más...déjame descansar...

dialog.english:
Wow, a soccer ball! Hey, wanna
play soccer?
Sounds fun!

How about we split into a human
team and a Digimon team?
dialog.translation:
¿Qué tal si hacemos un equipo
de humanos y otro Digimon?

dialog.english: What's soccer?
Soccer is like this...
Soccer is like this...

How can you play soccer at a time
like this?
dialog.translation:
¿Cómo jugáis al fútbol en un
momento así?

dialog.english: Ghighigi! Merci for coming!
Kyaaaaaaaaah! H-he's here!

Calm down! It's another
three-dimensional image of Etemon,
like the one from before!
dialog.translation:
¡Tranquilos! ¡Es otra imagen
en 3D de Etemon, como la
de antes!

dialog.english: Wait, guys...!
Ah!
Agumon!
Tai! Guys!
Agumon!
The soccer goal was a trap!

He was tryin' to tie us all up in
this net!
dialog.translation:
¡Quería atraparnos a todos
en esta red!

dialog.english:
My, don't touch the net. There's a
high-voltage current flowing
through it.
dialog.translation:
No toquéis la red. Tiene
corriente de alto voltaje
pasando por ella.

dialog.english:
There's a high-voltage current
flowing through it.
dialog.translation:
Hay corriente de alto voltaje
pasando por ella.

dialog.english: What?! Let us out!
Aw, 'fraid I can't, boy...

Really, I'd love to be your
opponent, but unfortunately I'm
too far away right now!
dialog.translation:
¡De verdad me encantaría
ser tu rival, pero por
desgracia estoy muy lejos!

dialog.english:
But don't worry, I've prepared a
special guest instead!
dialog.translation:
¡Pero tranquilos, os he
preparado un invitado especial!

dialog.english: A special guest?

I'm sure you'll be surprised!
Hip-hip, hooray!
Guys! Are you okay?
The soccer goal was a trap!

They caught us all up in the
net...
dialog.translation:
Nos atraparon a todos en
la red...

dialog.english:
Ah, best not to touch that!
There's a high-voltage current
running through the net!
dialog.translation:
¡Ah, mejor no tocarlo!
¡Tiene corriente de alto
voltaje pasando por la red!

dialog.english:
There's a high-voltage current
running through the net!
dialog.translation:
¡Hay corriente de alto voltaje
pasando por la red!

dialog.english: Let everyone go!
Oops, there's one left...

Really, I'd love to be your
opponent, but unfortunately I'm
too far away right now!
dialog.translation:
¡De verdad me encantaría
ser tu rival, pero por
desgracia estoy muy lejos!

dialog.english:
But don't worry, I've prepared a
special guest instead!
dialog.translation:
¡Pero tranquilos, os he
preparado un invitado especial!

dialog.english: A special guest?

I'm sure you'll be surprised!
Hip-hip, hooray!
A G-Greymon?!
Told you you'd be surprised...

Enjoy my spectacular production!
Well then, let's start! It's
showtime!
dialog.translation:
¡Disfrutad mi espectáculo!
¡Pues bien, empecemos!
¡Es la hora del show!

dialog.english: Agumon, evolve!
Fight on, Greymon!
You can't lose to a faker!
You've got to evolve, Greymon!!

The fight won't end well, at this
rate.
dialog.translation:
Así la pelea no acabará
bien.

dialog.english: Unless he evolves, he's a goner.

Evolve! Greymon, you have to
evolve!

It's not working, Tai, your
Crest isn't reacting.
dialog.translation:
No funciona, Tai, tu
Emblema no reacciona.

dialog.english: He can't evolve!

He can do it! Greymon, you can do
it! Believe in your own power!
dialog.translation:
¡Puedes hacerlo! ¡Cree en
tu propio poder, Greymon!

dialog.english:
Don't his movements look a bit
slower than normal?
dialog.translation:
¿No se mueve más lento de lo
normal?

dialog.english:
That's right! His body is heavy
because he ate too much!

My, my, it looks like it's going
to end already. How boring.
dialog.translation:
Vaya, vaya, parece que esto
ya acaba. Qué aburrido.

dialog.english:
We have to find a way out of here
as soon as possible!
But how...aaah?!
G-Guys!
Ow. Are you guys okay?

Seems like we're all fine, but
where are we?
dialog.translation:
Parece que estamos bien,
pero ¿dónde estamos?

dialog.english:
Seems like there are some ruins in
the colosseum basement.
dialog.translation:
Parece que hay ruinas en el
sótano del coliseo.

dialog.english:
Greymon's still fighting up there!
Let's hurry up and get back to the
surface!
dialog.translation:
¡Greymon sigue luchando
arriba! ¡Volvamos rápido
a la superficie!

dialog.english: Ah, Tai!
Let's follow Tai!
Ow. Are you guys okay?

Seems like we're all fine, but
where are we?
dialog.translation:
Parece que estamos bien,
pero ¿dónde estamos?

dialog.english:
Looks like there are some ruins in
the colosseum basement.
dialog.translation:
Parece que hay ruinas en el
sótano del coliseo.

dialog.english:
The Tag hasn't been reacting as
strongly. I think we got separated
from the Crest when we fell.
dialog.translation:
El Circuito no reacciona
tan fuerte. Creo que nos
separamos del Emblema al caer.

dialog.english:
But Tai and Greymon are still
up there.
dialog.translation:
Pero Tai y Greymon siguen
arriba.

dialog.english:
We have to get back to the surface
and find the Crest anyway.
dialog.translation:
Debemos volver arriba y
buscar el Emblema igualmente.

dialog.english:
Yeah! Having another Crest can't
hurt us.
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! Tener otro Emblema no
nos vendría mal.

dialog.english:
The Tag's reaction is getting
stronger! The Crest must be here!
dialog.translation:
¡El Circuito reacciona más
fuerte! ¡El Emblema debe
estar aquí!

dialog.english: We did it! Let's hurry, Joe!

Hey, the Tag was reacting here,
wasn't it?!

We can't go this way! The road's
blocked!

The Tag's definitely reacting to
something around here!
dialog.translation:
¡El Circuito sin duda
reacciona a algo de aquí!

dialog.english:
We don't have time, so we'll have
to take a detour!
dialog.translation:
¡No tenemos tiempo, así
que daremos un rodeo!

dialog.english: Ah! The road's blocked!

The Tag's definitely reacting to
something from here!
dialog.translation:
¡El Circuito sin duda
reacciona a algo de aquí!

dialog.english:
Can't be helped, we'll have to
take a detour!
dialog.translation:
¡No hay más remedio,
daremos un rodeo!

dialog.english: No way! It's a dead end.

It's not! This wall's like the one
where Tai found his Crest.
dialog.translation:
¡No lo es! Este muro es
igual al de Tai, donde
halló su Emblema.

dialog.english: Ah! The wall...it glowed!

Just like it did with mine! Joe,
the Crest?
dialog.translation:
¡Igual que con el mío! Joe,
¿el Emblema?

dialog.english: It's in my Tag!
We did it! We found Joe's Crest!
Let's go! Wait for me, Greymon!
A wall! It's a dead end here...

It's not! This wall's like the one
where Tai found his Crest.
dialog.translation:
¡No lo es! Este muro es
igual al de Tai, donde
halló su Emblema.

dialog.english: It glowed! Joe, the Crest?
It's in my Tag!
We did it! We found Joe's Crest!
Let's hurry back to Tai!
Greymooooooooooon!
The children have returned!
Greymon's gonna lose at this rate!

You can win if you evolve! But
only if you evolve!
Tai! Watch out!

Don't get in the way! This is my
chance to get Greymon to evolve!
dialog.translation:
¡No os metáis! ¡Es mi
oportunidad de hacer
evolucionar a Greymon!

dialog.english: Tai!

You can win if you evolve! But
only if you evolve!
We're finally back!
Tai's here!
Tai!
The children have returned!
Greymon's gonna lose at this rate!
Tai! We'll back you up!

Don't get in the way! This is my
chance to get Greymon to evolve!
dialog.translation:
¡No os metáis! ¡Es mi
oportunidad de hacer
evolucionar a Greymon!

dialog.english: Tai! Watch out!
I'm not afraid of you! Bring it!

Ah, I see trying to look cool!
Well, I'll flatten you, just like
you wanted!
dialog.translation:
¡Ah, veo que quieres
quedar bien! ¡Pues te
aplastaré, como querías!

dialog.english:
I...I believe in you! You have to
evolve! Greymoooooon!
T-this is...
What's going on?
No way...that's SkullGreymon!
I-is this Greymon's evolved form?
Ehhhh?! My Greymon! My Network!

SkullGreymon! Are you really
Greymon's evolved form?
dialog.translation:
¡SkullGreymon! ¿De verdad eres
la evolución de Greymon?

dialog.english: Snap out of it! Run, Tai!
Aaaaaaaah!
We have to find a way to stop him!
Okay, let's go, guys!
What happened?
Did he run out of energy?
He went back to being Koromon.
Are you okay?

Y-yeah, but it looks like I did
some pretty awful things to you
guys.
dialog.translation:
S-sí, pero parece que os
hice cosas horribles a
todos vosotros.

dialog.english: I couldn't do anything...
Don't worry about it.
Yeah.

I just ended up disappointing you,
I'm really sorry...
dialog.translation:
Al final os decepcioné,
lo siento mucho...

dialog.english:
No! It wasn't your fault! The one
at fault was...!
I know. It was me.
T-that's not what I meant...

Before I knew it, I was getting
all impatient because I had the
Crest.
dialog.translation:
Sin darme cuenta, me
impacienté por tener
el Emblema.

dialog.english:
I felt like I had to fight by
myself...
dialog.translation:
Sentí que debía luchar
yo solo...

dialog.english:
I'm sorry, guys. I'm sorry,
Koromon...
